findings.detail: Reads fixed F/experiment-plan.json, while plan author supports immutable versioned final paths. Does not bind the copied protocol-review-immutable.json to that plan or actual result inputs. Wrong/stale owner inventory can be retained without rejecting result provenance.
findings.recommended_fix: Require explicit --plan and protocol review pin; verify summary/result plan binding and plan owner pins against the final reviewed bytes.

findings.detail: Checks original checkpoint before copy; observed retained_bytes are recorded but never required equal original bytes/SHA. Source files have the same gap. No consumed source closing fence; source_checkpoint_bytes_unchanged=True is unconditional.
findings.recommended_fix: Copy each pinned source into a fresh ordinary target, require byte and digest equality, then rehash every consumed original before admitting manifest. Derive unchanged claim only after these checks.

findings.detail: Summary lists eight local raw lane reports but publication copies only derived diagnostics, summary, equivalence and protocol review. Exact source proposal/abstention evidence remains absent from the publication.
findings.recommended_fix: Retain all eight exact raw reports bound by summary. Keep explicit external source/cache/native input and portability limitations unless those original inputs are also included.

findings.detail: Dictionary comprehension overwrites four checkpoint records per name; does not require eight lanes, exact four controls, both names, or same checkpoint per lane name.
findings.recommended_fix: Verify exact 2x4 lane/control coverage and shared reviewed checkpoint pin for each name before deduplicating.

findings.detail: Produces actual_optimizer_updates=0 and exposure/holdout claims without validating the consumed summary schema, zero counters, source count or complete lane coverage; report pins checked only on opening.
findings.recommended_fix: Validate exact completed frozen summary contract and 8 ordered source occurrences x8 lanes; bind plan scope or actual reviewed summary claims. Closing-rehash summary, reports and previous diagnostics.

findings.detail: json.loads uses default duplicate/nonfinite behavior; analyzer read permits arbitrary small JSON shape. Current writer emits strict ordinary JSON but helper own input boundary does not establish that.
findings.recommended_fix: Reuse stdlib strict duplicate/nonfinite/surrogate JSON reader and explicit bounded input shape checks if helpers are intended beyond this frozen curated receipt set.

next_review: Read actual finalized raw results, resource receipts and exact final release inventory/README before upload; write a new immutable review version for revised root helper bytes.
qualification_limits: Cannot approve future actual result counts or publication package/README final outcomes before files exist.
Does not constitute upload authorization or guarantee publication transaction preservation.
scope: Independent static review of root-authored pure analysis and local publication preparation helpers; excludes reviewer-authored cache/runner/equivalence qualification
supported_findings: Both helpers are stdlib-only and import no numerical models or network clients. Neither executes training/encoding/HF upload.

Analyzer uses authoritative retained decoder_row canonical IR/span diagnostics and explicit refusal counts; it states semantic_accuracy null and distinguishes literal copying from reviewed legal roles/modality.

Publication README accurately distinguishes warm-start continuation lineage from native-dimensional checkpoints, normative32 and byte259 transport; raw GTE recipe versus transformed384 is not relabelled.

README declares previous authored training targets, eight exposed development sources, no new accuracy or independent holdout, no new model selection, no Lake/default promotion and missing standalone dependency/portable replay closure.
